records.name: Laura Frost
records.priorTitle: Provost & Executive VP for Academic Affairs (concurrently); previously Associate Dean for Faculty Affairs and Research, CAS
records.notes: Serving as Interim Dean of CAS while also Provost, after Clay Motley moved to associate provost role in 2026. Exact transition month not specified on source page.

records.name: Clay Motley
records.priorTitle: Dean of the Honors College
records.notes: Named interim dean Aug 2022, formally appointed permanent dean by March 2023. Moved to Associate Provost for Faculty Success & Academic Resources in 2026.

records.name: Chuck (Charles) Lindsey
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Arts & Sciences / Professor of Mathematics
records.notes: Named interim dean June 2019; permanently appointed dean in April 2020. One of FGCU's founding faculty members, having served 10+ years as assistant/associate dean before this role.

records.name: Todd Rosenstiel
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Liberal Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Appointed dean effective May 1, 2025, following a national search.

records.name: Lindsey Cohen
records.priorTitle: Distinguished University Professor of Psychology and Department Chair (2020-2023)
records.notes: Appointed interim dean effective January 1, 2024 after Sara Rosen stepped down; served until Rosenstiel's arrival.

records.name: Sara Rosen
records.priorTitle: Senior Vice Provost for Academic Affairs / Interim Provost and EVC
records.notes: Appointment effective August 17, 2016; stepped down as dean at the end of 2023.

seats.school: Pew Faculty Teaching and Learning Center

records.name: Christine Rener
records.priorTitle: Director of Faculty Development, Director of Assessment, HLC Self-Study Coordinator, Professor of Chemistry
records.priorInstitution: Not specified (prior institution before joining GVSU)
records.notes: Rener joined GVSU in 2009 and currently serves as Vice Provost for Instructional Development and Innovation and Director of the Robert and Mary Pew Faculty Teaching and Learning Center (Pew FTLC). Exact year she became FTLC director, and any predecessor directors, could not be confirmed from available public sources; this is a small center rather than an academic college, so limited leadership history is publicly documented.

records.name: Erica Chito Childs
records.priorTitle: Senior Associate Dean; Professor and Chair, Sociology
records.notes: Became Acting Dean of the (Ruth and Harold Newman) School of Arts and Sciences on June 15, 2024, succeeding Andrew Polsky; named permanent dean following a national search announced March 16, 2026.

records.name: Andrew Polsky
records.priorTitle: Professor of Political Science
records.notes: Served 11 years as the Ruth and Harold Newman Dean of the School of Arts and Sciences, stepping down in 2024; remained on the Political Science faculty afterward.

records.name: Heather Dillaway
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Liberal Arts and Sciences; Professor of Sociology
records.notes: Appointment announced Feb 9, 2022; began role July 16, 2022, succeeding interim dean Diane Zosky.

records.name: Diane Zosky
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean / Faculty, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Served as interim dean until Dillaway took over on July 16, 2022. Exact start date as interim is approximate.

records.name: Gregory Simpson
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed
records.notes: Documented as Dean of the College of Arts and Sciences in activities from at least 2014 through 2018; exact start/end years are approximate based on available records.

records.name: Melinda R. Roberts
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, College of Liberal Arts; Professor of Criminal Justice
records.notes: Began as Dean of the College of Arts and Sciences on March 31, 2026. The specific interim/permanent leadership of CAS between Christopher Olsen's 2021 departure and Roberts's 2026 start could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Christopher Olsen
records.priorTitle: Department Chair (13 years); ISU faculty since 1999
records.notes: Named interim dean of the College of Arts and Sciences in June 2016, later confirmed permanently; promoted to Provost and VP for Academic Affairs in December 2021.

records.name: Jillian Sokso
records.priorTitle: Director, School of Art
records.notes: Appointed interim dean of the College of the Arts effective July 1, 2026, after joining Kent State as School of Art director in 2022.

records.name: Diane Petrella
records.priorTitle: Dean
records.notes: Appointed dean of the College of the Arts in 2021 (announced June 28, 2021); departed in 2026 reportedly to become Senior VP and Provost at Marshall University. Predecessor prior to Petrella not confirmed.

records.name: Troy Blanchard
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Humanities & Social Sciences; Professor of Sociology
records.notes: LSU's former College of Arts and Sciences was reorganized into the College of Humanities & Social Sciences (and a separate College of Science). Blanchard served as Associate Dean 2014-2019, briefly as interim dean in 2019, then was formally named dean in November 2019. Predecessor as dean not confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Richard Fox
records.priorTitle: Professor of Political Science; Director, International Relations Program; Associate Dean, BCLA
records.notes: Effective June 1, 2024, succeeding Robbin D. Crabtree. Full college name is the Bellarmine College of Liberal Arts (BCLA).

records.name: Robbin D. Crabtree
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed
records.notes: Named dean around April 2014, serving nearly a decade through the end of the 2023-24 academic year. Predecessor not confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Peter J. Schraeder
records.priorTitle: Professor of International Relations; Department Chair, Political Science (2012-2020)
records.notes: Serving as dean since July 2020. Predecessor as dean of the College of Arts and Sciences could not be confirmed from available sources (an earlier dean, Isiaah Crawford, is documented as having served circa 2004-2008, but there is a gap in confirmed leadership between then and 2020).

records.name: Gary Emmert
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed (faculty, College of Arts & Sciences)
records.notes: Appointed Interim Dean of the College of Arts & Sciences, announced May 13, 2025, succeeding Abby Parrill-Baker.

records.name: Abby Parrill-Baker
records.priorTitle: Professor of Chemistry
records.notes: Served as Dean of the College of Arts and Sciences from 2019; also served as interim provost around 2022. Predecessor as dean not confirmed from available sources.

records.name: John Masserini
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, College of Social and Behavioral Sciences (2020-21); Vice Provost for Academic Affairs (2018-20); Professor of Music
records.notes: Joined MSU Denver in July 2021 as Dean of what is now called the College of Letters, Arts and Sciences (CLAS) - the successor unit to the former College of Arts and Humanities. Prior 13 years at Northern Arizona University. Exact transition date from a predecessor dean was not confirmed; some sources reference dean Joan (Laura) Foster serving approximately 12 years in a related arts/humanities dean role.

records.name: Joan (Laura) Foster
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed
records.notes: Reported to have served approximately 12 years as dean of the College of Arts and Humanities / related predecessor unit before stepping down; exact start year and precise end date could not be confirmed from available public sources.

records.name: Leah Tolbert Lyons
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean (2019); Interim Dean (2021), College of Liberal Arts; Professor of Global Studies
records.notes: MTSU alumna; became associate dean in 2019, interim dean by early 2021, and permanent dean in 2022.

records.name: Karen Petersen
records.priorTitle: Faculty, Political Science
records.notes: Served as interim dean of the College of Liberal Arts following Mark Byrnes's departure; exact end date approximate.

records.name: Mark Byrnes
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed
records.notes: Served as dean of the College of Liberal Arts from 2010 to 2016, when he became interim provost.

records.name: Shawn Wahl
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Arts and Letters (2019-2023); Interim Dean (2017-2019); Department Head, Communication
records.notes: Became founding dean of the newly formed Judith Enyeart Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences and Humanities (RCASH) in 2023, a merger of the former College of Arts and Letters (which he had led as interim dean from 2017 and permanent dean from Feb 2019) and the College of Humanities and Public Affairs.

records.name: Victor Matthews
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed
records.notes: Served as Dean of the College of Humanities and Public Affairs (the other predecessor college merged into RCASH) from 2009 until his retirement on June 30, 2023.

records.name: Rubén Polendo
records.priorTitle: Professor and former Chair, Department of Drama; Founding Director, Tisch Innovation Studio; Associate Dean
records.priorInstitution: New York University (Tisch School of the Arts)
records.notes: Appointed Dean of Tisch School of the Arts effective August 4, 2025, succeeding Allyson Green.

records.name: Allyson Green
records.priorTitle: Professional artist, curator and educator (Chair, Department of Dance, Tisch)
records.priorInstitution: New York University (Tisch School of the Arts)
records.notes: Named dean by NYU President John Sexton and Provost David McLaughlin, announced April 30, 2014; succeeded Mary Schmidt Campbell.

records.name: Mary Schmidt Campbell
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed
records.notes: Served approximately 20 years as dean of Tisch School of the Arts, becoming dean emerita in 2014; exact start year approximate.
